The <b>{{lc:{{PAGENAME}}}}</b> is a storage device, very similar to the [[trunk]], except its contents are limited to 20 (5x4) unique items - identical to the player's inventory, and one less row than the aforementioned trunk. Two of them are already built in the [[Sweet Home]] and those are indestructible. In addition to the [[Sweet Home]] chests, two of them can be built in the [[Church]], and 2 more in the [[Souls room]] with the [[Better Save Soul]] DLC.
